arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Calib CP boat 95 W, shaft 153 W (may be 10-25% off). Start hot (shaft 225 W). Goal: settle near CP by min 3, even effort, reserve ~0 at finish, final sprint last ~400-600 m. Leg 1 into current (-0.27 m/s) so slow GPS pace on this leg is current, not paddler. Judge effort by shaft power and pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac), not boat-speed numbers.

arguments.text: Min 4 (670 m): settled to shaft 161 W (CP 153, sustainable 156), pod reserve 51%, boat reserve 40%. Paddler says 5/10 steady, feels fine -> CP may be underestimated (or misjudging). No cue yet. Check at ~min 12-15: if fade_pct stays ~0 and they still feel easy while above CP, consider raising cp_shaft (one of 3 uses) and asking a small push.

text: no cue: effort has settled just above critical power, close to the sustainable level; paddler feels 5/10, noted possible CP underestimate to check later.
no cue: shaft power 160 W is only about 4 W above the sustainable level and fade is slight; watching whether the pod reserve keeps draining before asking any change.

Min 10 (1740 m, leg 2 downstream +0.28): shaft crept to 166 W, pod reserve 30% (drain ~3.5%/min, empties ~min 18 if held). Boat reserve 0% but no fade (+1.8%) -> boat CP 95 likely low; pod model trusted more. Paddler 6/10 fine. Cued EASE a touch (no pace target, current flips at turns). Plan: ~150-155 W downstream, ~160 upstream legs. Re-check fade + pod reserve at next wake-up; if reserve stops falling at ~158 W, CP higher.

text: Cued ease a touch on the downstream leg: shaft power 166 W was draining the pod reserve (30%) toward empty by about min 18.

no cue: upstream leg at shaft 160 W fits the plan (a little harder against the current, easier with it); no fade, pod reserve 19% draining slowly.

arguments.text: Min 17 (3000 m): paddler volunteered feeling good, steady. Shaft 154-158 W, pod reserve 18%, no fade (+1%). Boat reserve 0% since min 11 at boat 103-110 W with no fade -> boat CP 95 is too low (pod/boat ratio eta ~0.64, so pod CP 153 ~ boat 98-100). cp_implied_w not yet available (check ~min 22; do NOT pull long get_metric_series, output is huge). If no fade and feels good by min 25, consider raising cp_shaft ~5% and a small push.

text: no cue: paddler feels good and is holding the sustainable shaft power with no fade; keeping the even plan and gathering evidence on whether critical power is set too low.

arguments.text: Min 24.5 (4300 m, leg 4 downstream): cp_implied_w 106 W (boat), paddler 4/10 feels fine, no fade since start -> SET CP boat 106, shaft 163 (1 of 3 uses). Cued PUSH (lift pressure a little), aim shaft ~163-168 upstream, ~160 downstream. Watch fading (fade_pct<-3 for 45 s) = sign CP too high -> ease back and lower cp. hot_downstream watch raised to 174 W. Next: check shaft response and fade after turn (~min 28).

text: Raised critical power (boat 106 W, shaft 163 W) on the race evidence and paddler 4/10, and cued a small push; fade watch set to catch it if wrong.

Watch for push_local below push_along (GPS slower than pod power predicts): at min 28 was -0.33 vs -0.27, likely turn mixing; recheck. Next: confirm shaft ~165 and no fade.

Min 29.8 (5270 m): paddler said boat feels heavy, rudder? Data agree: speed through water 2.91 vs 3.02 earlier upstream at same shaft ~157, push_local 0.05 below push_along (was 0.04 above) -> ~0.09 m/s extra drag since ~min 28. Cued CLEAR_RUDDER. Next: check speed_water and push_local minus push_along recover; if not, ask paddler / cue again.

text: Cued clear_rudder: the paddler feels the boat heavy and speed through the water is about 3.5% down at the same shaft power since about min 28, which fits weed on the rudder.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, speed is back. Now lift the pressure, you have reserve.

Min 32.8 (5750 m): rudder clear worked (speed water 2.98-3.00 at shaft 156, push_local = push_along again). Shaft stuck ~156 despite push cues at 24.4 and 28.7 (rudder cue may have replaced the 2nd). Pushed again. Pod reserve 29% under CP 163, sustainable 165. If push still ignored, try ask_paddler then a push with words about the reserve.

text: Rudder clearing worked, speed is back; cued a push again because shaft power 156 W is 9 W below what they can hold to the finish.

arguments.text: Min 38.8 (6830 m): pace-target push WORKED: shaft 167-173, ground pace 151 (target 150), paddler 6/10 fine, fade +1.2%. Speed gain small (~1-2%) for +10% power. Pod reserve 27% (CP 163), draining. At the 7500 m turn: cue push/hold with UPSTREAM pace ~181 (about 167 W), not 150. Leg 8 downstream (8750-10000) ~151-152; leg 9 upstream to 11250; finish sprint from ~10750.

text: no cue: the pace-target push is working (2:31 ground pace, 6/10, no fade); will replace the target at the 7500 m turn so they do not chase a downstream pace upstream.

Plan: hold ~157 to the end, reset pace target at 8750 turn (watch) to ~153 downstream, then at 10000 turn hold ~186 upstream, FINISH sprint at ~550 m to go (watch).
